evidence:
Independent row-17 review found no requested feature/screen without a plausible implementation. Scope is public deliverable coverage, not a claim of Oracle or configured-judge success. Paths below are beneath .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r1/task unless an evidence-run path is named.

Requirement-to-implementation walk: instruction.md paragraphs 1-4 and hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 request the base offer desk, roles, exact financial derivations, retained history and usable screens. public/js/app.js:13-20 registers all six views. public/index.html:19-36 supplies email/password sign-in for all seven named accounts; src/index.js:70-114 resolves identity from stored sessions and enforces 401/403. public/js/hireops.js:44-89 implements requisition creation and movement-backed headroom; :121-262 implements PENDING offer creation with all six terms, original/referral start inputs, distinct run-rate/band basis, approve/revise/rescind controls and history; :264-319 exposes grants, cancellations and referral recipient/split/cliff; :321-417 exposes readable audit rows and expandable structured before/after receipts. All raw and defined financial figures are rendered from server-computed views. Optional dashboard/theme/phone layout and optional demonstration history were not treated as mandatory.

The corresponding writes are implemented in src/index.js:296-405: direct requisition/PENDING creation, dual-control and tiered approval, current-leaf revision, signed bonus differences, replacement grants, unchanged referral association, finance-only rescission and before/after receipts are enclosed in SQLite transactions. Readbacks at :135-224 expose raw terms, derived amounts, grants, vesting settlements, lineage payments and historical records. Append-only receipt/audit mutation routes refuse at :414-422. src/rules.js:24-52 validates real dates and computes clamped UTC anniversaries with milliseconds plus exact BigInt arithmetic; :55-99 composes intrinsic/annualized equity, run-rate and half-bonus approval basis; :103-151 separates signing/equity/referral clocks; :154-182 derives headroom and net signing payments from movements/history. These satisfy the public conventions without requiring route names or generated-ID formats.

The coordinated contract in hireops_rules.md:423-480 is implemented by src/change-sets.js:22-37 (2-4 distinct sources, every replacement term, canonical order-independent intent), :38-64 (all source releases and destination commitments netted together with final budget/overflow validation), :77-92 (durable non-economic preview and immutable actor-scoped operation key), :13-16 and :94-104 (append-only ledger version freshness, current leaves, owner authorization before cached receipt), and :105-141 (all successors/movements/grants/payments posted in one immediate transaction, then final-state member after-images and durable batch receipt). Saved receipts return before current-state revalidation at :98, including after a later revision/rescission. public/js/change-sets.js:39-85 supplies ordinary labelled member/target/term controls, preview and commit; :11-37 and :90 provide saved readable results and retry of the same saved operation. Error branches :35 and :83 preserve the editor. public/js/app.js:173-207 preserves revision/rescission drawer inputs on refusal, including the effective date.

Runtime delivery is present in server.js plus src/bootstrap.js (one Node process, public PORT listener, immediate database-independent health and worker-served UI/API), src/db.js:12-27 (DB_PATH and bundled seed) and :116-182 (seed once), and solve.sh (copies self-contained ordinary app files). This row does not substitute for the dedicated runtime-contract checks.

Actual product evidence was inspected rather than inferred from a checklist: current-run local/domain/results.json reports successful account/role matrix, exact arithmetic and date boundaries, ordinary revision/rescission history, invalid-input refusal, concurrency and process replacement; its driver assertions were read. local/batch-domain.cjs and results.json exercise 15 groups including fully committed two-requisition exchange, offsetting changes, no preview effects, same-key intent behavior, malformed/over-budget refusal, ABA freshness, stale second member, unrelated operations, overlapping/disjoint concurrent commits, authorization, original receipt retries and restart. local/batch-ui.cjs/results.json exercises real labelled form preview/commit, stale-editor retention, a forwarded successful server commit whose browser response is aborted, same-operation UI retry without duplicate effects, and independent Auditor readback. local/legacy-ui.cjs/results.json exercises ordinary desk form changes, all six revision terms, exact large values, retained invalid dates/over-budget edits and rescission-date retry. The committed-desktop screenshot visibly shows the ordinary editor, saved headroom/offer transitions and original-receipt control.

I independently recomputed current-run raw index hashes (all matched) and compared embedded source bindings against the frozen task: domain 37 files, batch-domain 4 server files, batch-ui 14 solution files, legacy-ui 13 app files, and install-lifecycle 13 app files all matched. The domain driver hash also matches its recorded provenance. These are bounded local execution observations, not full configured judge timing or a provider/portal score.

Counterexamples considered: a plausible app using only equal headroom to judge freshness would miss ABA; one revalidating current leaves on every retry would lose the original committed result; one applying sequential budget gates would refuse a fully funded cycle. The actual batch-witnesses driver implements those mutations, and its verified results show 200 instead of expected 409 for ABA, 409 instead of 200 for cached receipt, and refusal of the funded exchange respectively. This is product-test discrimination, not claimed reward discrimination. A conforming desk with no optional operational seed history remains accepted: the empty_operational_seed witness passes the same 15 coordinated domain groups. The reference's implementation and these observations cover the requested outcomes without requiring that optional seed roster or an exact layout.
